headline: Malaysia plans a sovereign AI cloud to keep its citizens' data and strategic information under national control, its prime minister announced in the 2027 budget.
score_reason: Curator score kept; an official budget announcement, but the cloud is only planned and has no cost or date.
importance_line: What changed: Malaysia is putting public money behind keeping data and AI capability at home, which affects Malaysian citizens and businesses first, then foreign cloud providers, though no cost, date or provider is given for the cloud.
summary: The Rakyat Post reports that Prime Minister and Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim said on 9 Oct 2026, presenting Budget 2027, that Malaysia is planning a Sovereign AI Cloud to keep citizens' data and strategic information under Malaysian control. The budget also adds 100,000 free AI subscriptions for young people and an AI app to check phone numbers, bank accounts and links for scams, and sets aside RM6 billion across ministries for research, development and commercialisation.
notes: Read in full at The Rakyat Post.
